notes.notes:

notes.title: Character Growth System Now Available! 1.0.4 Version Update Announcement
notes.notes:
Dear investigators, we have completed the update for version 1.0.4. The specific updates are as follows:

●Character Growth System:
○Different endings of all scenarios will provide corresponding experience points, which will be given to the investigator character used in this session.
○When the experience points reach the upgrade condition, the investigator will gain new abilities:
■Attribute Points: These can be freely allocated to health, sanity, and the four basic attributes, allowing you to customize the investigator's abilities.
■Talents: We have reset the talent rules. Now each investigator can have up to 5 talents and carry a maximum of 3 into a scenario.
■Passive Skills: Each investigator will have 2 sets of brand new passive skills and can activate 1 skill from each set. These skills can compensate for the investigator's weaknesses or enhance their strengths, creating a new gameplay style.
■Cards: Each investigator will have new cards. Check out their strength after the update and give us your feedback!

All of the above content can be freely configured and adjusted before each game session. With the same investigator character, you can play in your own style!
As the growth system is updated, we will convert and distribute corresponding experience points based on the achievements that existing players have already accomplished, allowing everyone to quickly experience the new content.

●"Residences of Karma" Script:
○Added a random level where you will face a new boss called "Desire's Bondage".
○Added an "Elevator Room" section before the final level, where investigators can recover and have more advantageous options such as duplicating/deleting cards, obtaining advanced cards or treasures.

●"Night of the Mysteries" Script:
[b]○Added "Zombie Tide Escape" mode: When the Chester's bell rings, the mansion may be attacked by a zombie tide. You need to escape while completing your secret mission, cooperate with like-minded allies, and beware of suspicious teammates. Remember, the longer you stay in this mansion, the more likely you will be transformed into a member of the zombie tide![/b]
○Fixed the issue where the "Invisibility Cloak" could be actively used.
○Fixed the incorrect judgment of the "Invisibility Cloak", it now requires that there are no enemies in your area to trigger the effect.
○Fixed the inconsistency issue with the "Spirit Blade" equipment and its derived cards.
○Fixed the issue where using the "Hypnosis Device" would cause investigators to continuously suffer injuries leading to death when moving at least two squares in a burning room.
○Fixed the issue where the regular skill of the alien (reduce 1 action point cost for the first spell card) would show as available. This issue would cause the game to crash under specific circumstances.

●Fix the issue of the model of the scientific expedition team members in the script "North of the North Pole" being able to pass through walls and see through them.
●Fix an issue that causes the hand cards to disappear and have invisible hand cards.

We will continue to optimize this issue based on everyone's actual gameplay.

○[b] Improving the problem of the "Spider Queen" BOSS being too powerfu[/b]l. On the one hand, this is a design issue, and on the other hand, it is also caused by BUG, which has prevented the advantages of the human side from being fully displayed. The main adjustments this time are:

② The number of cards drawn by the Spider Queen per round is reduced to 2.
③ The Spider Queen's card "Silk Road" will end the round immediately when it is teleported to a grid without a spider nest.
④ The small spiders will no longer trigger the dodge check.
⑤ Fixed the problems of fuel cards not being tradable, not returning to the hand when blocked, and not dropping when defeated.

● [b]Improving the balance of the "Residences of Karma":[/b]

○ [b]The difficulty of the final level is not reasonable enough.[/b] The specific adjustments are as follows:

① The amount of health restored by the "Human Sacrificer (Wood)" is reduced.
② The number of minions summoned by the "Human Sacrificer (Fire)" is reduced, and the minions summoned by the "Human Sacrificer (Fire)" will also die when the "Human Sacrificer (Fire)" dies.
③ The amount of curse cards inserted into the deck by the "Human Sacrificer (Earth)" is reduced.
④ The health of the "Illusion of Sanqing" is reduced.
⑤ The health of the "Dharmakaya of Shifu" is reduced.

○ Fixed the problem that some investigators cannot skip Spiritual Energy in some places.

[b]● Fixed a batch of BUGs that caused the game to freeze:[/b]

○ When the team leader selects the action order, the already acted team members will still appear in the available avatar, causing a series of abnormalities.
○ The exceptions related to the process of the "Red Sha" level, such as the wedding procession and the groom's wedding.
○ The exceptions related to the process of the "Ghost Doll Returns Home" level, such as competing with Kumantong.

Finally, what we want to say to everyone is that the "Residences of Karma" and "Night of the Mysteries" scripts launched this time are [b]intended to try game mechanisms with more repeatable playability. [/b]In the future, we will continue to optimize the experience and expand the content. Of course, [b]we will not give up the original investigative plot mode and will launch new scripts in the future.[/b]

We will provide a more detailed content list in the update announcement and continue to pay attention to your feedback to continuously improve the game. Please give us more patience and support. Thank you!

notes.title: New Scripts, New Characters, New Features! Officially Released on August 26th
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! We have confirmed that the official release date will be August 26th. At that time, we will end early access and bring a large version update, including two new scripts, script difficulty selection, new characters and character growth and customization functions, voice acting, and English language support!
[b][Two new scripts with new DBG and PVP gameplay][/b]
Different from previous scripts, the two new scripts added in the official version will bring new gameplay mechanisms and emphasize the replayability of scripts.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43132636/34886b8de1de3660db1444425f37c04bf9f637c9.png[/img]
The script of "Residences of Karma" features roguelike adventure and deck building game (DBG), where investigators will embark on an adventure in a mysterious old-style tenement building, enter random floors, create decks of different genres, and also encounter a ghost bride trapped by love, and experience immersive gameplay with various folk characteristics such as soul calling and corpse driving.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43132636/6a8186858bb45905b7c21a9be8106025aa6e988f.png[/img]
"Night of the Mysteries" is the first PVP mode script of "Dream Sketcher". The investigators will go to a haunted mansion to participate in the filming of a ghost-hunting variety show. It combines various classic horror movie scenes and even includes alien creatures. During one stage of the filming, one of the investigators will reveal their true identity, bringing a shocking twist...
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43132636/942d7cc794b7bdff1dbc3d2c2cb85003b1531c5a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43132636/5a01b910ac4cad215367ad1924f81f776edc08dc.png[/img]
Both of scripts use random map technology, so the layout and distribution of events on the map will be different each game, keeping things fresh for players.
[b][Character Growth and Customization: Build Your Own Unique Investigator][/b]
The highly requested character growth and customization feature is coming! As investigators gain experience, they will gradually unlock customizable attribute points, new specialties, new cards, and passive effects. Players can adjust their combinations at any time on the investigator character interface, trying out their own unique style and path!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43132636/4e9bcfeb53195ed05a1519999033ca444145af3f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43132636/70ff8918e5f4828ea71692dd4acf2226ba42aa2e.png[/img]
Note: Due to the need for more debugging time, this feature will be updated within September.
[b][New Journalist Character Joins, Card Mechanism Expands][/b]
The little journalist who left a deep impression on everyone in the "Murder Sanatorium" script will be added to the optional character lineup in the official version!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43132636/693c912b3d5ef93f852d54c7c6a562aaf6f62283.png[/img]
[b][Voice Acting, Difficulty Selection, and More Improvements][/b]
Based on the feedback during the early access, the development team has optimized the schedule in combination with their own situation. In this version update, you can see the preliminary results.
During the early access of "Dream Sketcher," enthusiastic players provided many constructive opinions and suggestions. The development team carefully recorded and digested them and, in combination with their own situation, began to optimize the schedule. You can see the preliminary results in this version update.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43132636/4c8e153134968b4440e21471ac27a82ac733380d.png[/img]
First, the game graphics and interaction details have undergone another round of upgrades, and each script has added voice acting to the plot, coupled with optimized music and sound effects, further enhancing the immersive experience during gameplay.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43132636/b02d2634d68f522772f3522b3dc79d0481cc046f.png[/img]
On this basis, the script difficulty selection function has also been officially implemented. Investigators who like challenges can come and face the punishment of more severe dice rolls.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43132636/71235c140d8e13f07f9cceefb432810fadd87aec.png[/img]
In addition, English language support has also been added to the official version, and the development team will continue to add more language support in the future to meet everyone's needs.
It should be noted that this update is not the end. In addition to DLC development, the development team will continue to update and improve the game for free, expand the plot gameplay, and bring new system functions such as achievements.
Although the team is limited in size and the update pace is not fast, with everyone's support, the development team will continue to work hard.
[b]Please invite your friends to join us and enter the dream world of "Dream Sketcher" together! Crack the mysterious dream on August 26th![/b]

notes.title: Explanation of the price increase & Screenshot and poster of the new script
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, this is the development team of "Dream Sketcher" from RisingPunch Studio.
As the new content development progresses and considering future official release plans and Steam platform policies, we have decided to [b]increase the standard selling price of "Dream Sketcher" from ￥36 to ￥48 starting on July 24, 2023, Beijing time.[/b]

There are two core reasons for choosing to increase the price at this time:
1.In the official version, we will expand the content to include 6 scripts and 6 investigator characters, as well as additional scenario difficulty options, character growth and customization, and more basic features. Continuing to sell the game at the original price of ￥36 will put us under significant cost recovery pressure and will not be conducive to stable development of new content in the future. The new adjusted price is still within the low range for indie games, and we still maintain our pricing strategy of "small profits and high sales."
2.According to Steam platform policy, the game cannot be discounted within 30 days after a price increase, so we chose to complete the price increase operation before the official release to avoid affecting the subsequent special sale activity plans.

notes.title: Development Log | Friends, Character Growth, New Storyline Gameplay and Research
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, this is Leizi, the producer of "Dream Sketcher".

It has been over a week since the "Early Access" release of "Dream Sketcher". Today I want to give you a brief introduction to some of our key work at this stage. At the end of the text, there is a survey for you to fill out to help us create content that better meets your expectations.

[b] [Dice optimization and script difficulty selection] [/b]
Based on everyone's feedback, [b] we have decided to further optimize the "Chaotic Dice" values: cancel the -6 and -5 dice faces, and control negative numbers to within -4. [/b]
According to current data statistics, the average success rate of a single player's check is between 70% and 80%, which meets our design expectations. However, the method of avoiding large negative dice faces such as -6 and -5 is to invest a lot of hand resources in checks, which contradicts the game habits of most players. After the modification, the hand resources invested by players in each check will be controlled within a more reasonable range. We will also guide players to invest cards reasonably in each check by optimizing the display effect of the success rate of the check.
The above changes will inevitably further reduce the difficulty of the script. [b]We will provide more challenging difficulty choices in the future. We do not want to increase the difficulty by simply modifying the dice value but to have more playable content to match[/b]. Therefore, the launch of this mode still requires everyone's patience.

[b] [Friend Function] [/b]
It really hurts when you meet a like-minded teammate but cannot add them as a friend at the end of the script. However, developing a complete in-game friend system will consume a lot of our development resources. [b]Therefore, we will first add the function of opening the teammate "Steam personal profile page" in the script room waiting interface, script, and script settlement interface, so that everyone can add each other as Steam friends.[/b]
This function will be implemented in the next update, and we will also add the function of inviting friends to join the script room in the future.

[b] [In-game achievements and character growth] [/b]
Currently, many investigators have stated that the game lacks clear guidance on the number of script endings achieved and the conditions met. In the future, we will add an in-game achievement system to provide richer achievements. After passing the script for the first time, players can view other achievement items and condition descriptions for that script. As the development of this feature takes time, we will first improve the description of Steam achievements.
We will also launch a character growth system to provide more motivation for repeated script challenges and achievement collections. [b] In short, as the investigator's character grows, they will unlock attribute points, expertise, new talent skills, and powerful cards that can be freely assigned. [/b]

[b] [New script gameplay] [/b]
In the future, we will release some free scripts with prominent gameplay mechanisms, shorter and more replayable, to bring more fun to investigators and make character growth more relaxed. Here's a sneak peek at the two scripts currently in preparation:
[b] Script 1: In-game card construction + cooperative defense [/b]
Defend in the survivor camp and resist waves of enemy attacks, with a focus on combat fun.
Players do not carry their own deck into the script, but use collected materials to build their own deck, with various development directions such as melee, ranged, bloodsucking, support enhancement, summoning, and tower building, which require situational and resource choices.
In this process, you will also encounter randomly appearing NPCs. After successfully rescuing them, some people will join the defense team, while others will provide special help, such as reinforcing defensive facilities, providing positive encounter effects, upgrading NPC abilities, and opening hidden passages.
[b] Script 2: BOSS chase + happy mutual pit [/b]
Evade the pursuit of a powerful BOSS and survive to the end.
Complete checks and random events on the map to obtain various types of prop cards. These prop cards can help you survive or harm your teammates, such as traps that do not distinguish between enemies and friends, closing designated doors, and spreading spreading toxins in designated locations.
There will be more events triggering the butterfly effect during the encounter phase...
[b] The above is only a part of the gameplay library we have reserved, and it does not represent the final plan. We hope to understand your opinions through the survey questionnaire and use them as the basis for our script design and adjustment. [/b]
In addition, the enrichment of music and sound effects, the improvement of voice-related functions, the improvement of graphics and animation effects have also been included in our schedule. Please be patient with us, and we will regularly report progress to everyone!


Finally, don't forget to fill out this questionnaire: [url=https://wj.qq.com/s2/12293197/aabb]《志怪者》调研问卷[/url]

notes.title: Development Log | "EA" Day 1 Fix Bugs
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, I'm Leizi, the producer of "Dream Sketcher". 

Yesterday was the first day of the "Early Access" release of "Dream Sketcher". As a team releasing our first game, we inevitably had some areas where we fell short. We have received various feedback from players, and we thank you all for your constructive criticism.
Today, I'd like to talk about the difficulty of the dice rolls and the script experience.

[b]As a pay-to-play game, we don't intentionally want to increase the game's difficulty. After all, we consider "multiple branches and endings" as our unique script feature, and we hope more players can smoothly explore and experience the content we've designed.[/b]

[u]After receiving feedback from players, we immediately adjusted the dice rolls by increasing the positive probability of rolling special symbols and removing absurdly large negative numbers.
[/u]
In addition, some investigators may find the new script "Journey To The Deep" too difficult, especially the second act's battle difficulty. We found that this was actually due to a ridiculous bug:
In the second act of "Journey To The Deep" script, when adding a feature to enemies during the sound wave emission test, it would mistakenly cause all enemies with this feature on the entire server. As more and more players reach this stage, the monsters' "genetic mutation" would continue to accumulate, resulting in even small insects having a series of BOSS-level "features," such as blocking, counterattacking, and sweeping, making it increasingly difficult for players to progress.

[u]Currently, this bug has been fixed through an update early this morning. The developer responsible for the bug will be punished by copying the negative feedback from players 100 times since he still has many tasks to complete.[/u]

In addition to the above-mentioned dice difficulty adjustments and optimization of the traitor section's process in the "North of the North Pole" script, a series of issues have also been updated. Please refer to our update notice for more information.

Finally, we will continue to improve:
1. Script difficulty selection: Basic difficulty suitable for the majority to enjoy story exploration; provide more challenging modes for interested players to challenge, and challenging high difficulty can earn achievements.
2. Completion display of script ending achievements: The first step is to make every ending into a Steam achievement. Later, we will add ending and achievement completion display in the game.
We will continue to optimize the details and gameplay flow of the released scripts based on your feedback. At the same time, we will speed up the production of new scripts and editors to meet your expectations. Thank you!

[h3]About the pricing of the "Early Access (EA)" version[/h3]

As a multiplayer online game, we hope to attract more players to join. [b]With the discount during the first week, you can get the game for just over 30 yuan, and in the future, we will also add free scenarios, investigators, and editor functions. You can confidently join in.[/b]

notes.title: Development Log 03 | Sharing Game Background and Script Design Concept
notes.notes:
Dear investigators, hello everyone!

Today, I mainly want to talk to you about the world view setting, plot content and gameplay of the game "Dream Sketcher", and share the growth and changes of the game, and also reveal some changes that will be presented to you in the future.

[h1]World Background of "Dream Sketcher"[/h1]

In the initial story, the investigators were just ordinary people living in the 1990s with some special abilities. However, as we wanted to tell more complex stories, the existing framework was no longer enough to support our ideas. Therefore, a sci-fi retro-futuristic world was born - investigators with special "Into the Dreamland" abilities living at the turn of the century, using the "Compass System" to enter the collective subconscious world of mankind called the "Dream Sea." They climb up consciousness islands facing collapse, solving various oddities that occur there, and exploring the secret behind the global "dementia crisis" and its power.
But why did the crisis erupt? Who is behind this mysterious force? What strange things will the investigators encounter? ... These questions are left for everyone to discover and explore in the game world!

[h1]Script Design for "Dream Sketcher"[/h1]

In "Dream Sketcher", each script has completely different background settings, map environments, NPCs, and main and branch quests, while also having a certain degree of freedom. Players can explore and investigate through random gameplay and key decisions to uncover the truth of the story and experience their own ending.
For example, the beginner's scenario "Into the Dreamland" is a "message in a bottle" that has survived a shipwreck and drifted into the sewers. The investigator will have to save the lost and drunken captain alone, uncovering the stories of his alcoholism and abandonment of his son. Through the beginner's guide incorporated into the scenario design, the investigator can learn how to become a great detective (including how to explore rooms, make skill checks, use cards, etc.).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43132636/0fa60050a1d5ba7d61ee29eb9c581e3746d14f08.jpg[/img]
After entering the snow-covered game "[b]North of the North Pole[/b]", you not only need to escape from the cold camp, but also find a way to deal with four NPCs who have lost their minds and exhibit "personalized madness". Some secrets buried deep in the ice, whispers of ancient power, and mysterious organizations will also constantly interfere with your actions in the dream.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43132636/2c2a7936959f4d373e99efb59ef660fa533f2327.png[/img]
"[b]Murder Sanatorium[/b]" is a hospital-style escape script, where investigators not only have to find a way to save themselves, but also encounter several NPCs who are also trapped. We have set up some mini-games to unlock punishments to enhance everyone's immersive experience; we have also prepared a "soul interrogation" - a key, whether to use it to save NPCs or keep it for oneself?
This play uses a randomized map, so even in the same area, the events/NPCs/monsters encountered during each game will be different. We also welcome everyone to experience it multiple times.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43132636/6360b7cc730a90382995468a1f3cc80db00e67a5.png[/img]
"[b]Journey To The Deep[/b]" will invite you to board a magnificent cruise ship, where there is a game room, gym, restaurant, and everything you need. However, you are not here for pleasure - your primary task is to find the mysterious contact person and successfully match the secret code with him/her. Be careful to deal with the temptation of "food" and the "threat" of unexpected people.
It is worth mentioning that there are many interesting interaction points on this map. You can interact with NPCs, chat, play with a claw machine, or have a meal in the restaurant. Maybe you can replenish your stamina and recover some values.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43132636/b490ebba77093e168fbcd93e1d78977c9e960e10.png[/img]
Chinese folk culture and traditional culture are themes that many players are interested in, and they are also themes that we really like. "[b]Lost Dance[/b]" is a special and mysterious script under this theme. So far, we have not publicly tested it, but only displayed its map in PV and store page information.
We have designed scenes, plots, and gameplay with extremely Chinese characteristics in the script, such as village folk customs, red and white weddings, and "wedding" gameplay. The monsters and ultimate bosses in this play are based on cultural legends and shaped by the Dream World view, which we believe can make everyone feel the unique atmosphere of Dream Sketcher.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43132636/e65fbff1491b71a37bdf5b0f778a73eb4ba45e35.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43132636/60ac8e827a25d8a202b9b510744c738374e17144.png[/img]
Of course, these are not all. [b]We have designed a consistent thread that connects seemingly independent stories without affecting the experience of each individual plot, hoping to present a unique and complete worldview of the human dream world,[/b] providing a better gaming experience for everyone.

[h1]Content optimization revealed for "Dream Sketcher"[/h1]

[b]1. Redesign game UI interface[/b]
We will optimize the sidebar design to include visual cues, background information, and character dialogues, reducing lengthy text descriptions to enhance reading efficiency for all.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43132636/80ceb635b327802f118f547c7c93cfa401792d1c.png[/img]
Adjusted UI interface (not final)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43132636/dd8a4ed3967138592c70a59301014cf08e2e1b6a.png[/img]
Original UI interface (all information piled up in the sidebar)


[b]2. Adjust all script plots, add plot performances and animations, and enrich the characterization of key NPCs.[/b]
Based on everyone's feedback, we have reorganized all the scripts (it can be said that we have almost rewritten most of the plot). We have also focused on arranging the roles of some special NPCs and redeveloped them, hoping to leave a lasting impression on everyone.


[b]3. Creating a game opening animation[/b]
It will be placed before the beginner's guide to strengthen the introduction and background of the game world, in order to enhance everyone's immersion during gameplay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43132636/68b491841658ad2c8d1acc04cf79f52c009a6d51.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43132636/82a9768922ccfe431baa4c3dd639eb1d703a6885.png[/img]
Opening animation spoiler (in production, not final result)

While striving to optimize the performance of each episode, we aim for a smoother story, more thrilling plot, and richer characters, leaving a deeper impression on everyone. The changes in these elements may also bring about changes in gameplay. We will share any new developments with you in a timely manner.

notes.title: "Dream Sketcher" Developme Log 02 | Development Philosophy
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, I'm Leizi, the producer of "Dream Sketcher".
Recently, our game participated in the Steam Next Fest, and many players have experienced the game. Thank you for your attention, support, suggestions, and criticism! With the upcoming testing opportunity, I would like to share with you the development process, future plans, and respond to some recent criticisms.
[h1]What kind of game is "The Monster Investigator"?[/h1]
"Dream Sketcher" is a 1-4 player online game that offers an entry-level TRPG experience. In the game, you will enter strange dreams, investigate evidence, face unknown entities, and use freely combined skill props (represented as cards) to deal with various enemies and scene mechanisms (including hidden elements), make plot choices, and lead to multiple branching endings.
As a small team of enthusiasts of Cthulhu, new horror stories, and adventure movies, we hope to create a short and fast-paced adventure investigation game: one case, a few hours, several puzzles, one big battle, that's what we expect from "Dream Sketcher".
[h1]The development philosophy of "Dream Sketcher"[/h1]
Inspired by the successful gameplay of TRPG, we had the idea of turning original adventure stories into an electronic game that everyone can play. We hope that players can experience concrete plots and scenes (talk to NPCs about case details, explore hidden passages behind chairs and tables), and have a certain space for prop combinations and strategic choices (bringing two C4 explosives for the "find the cat" mission makes sense), so we started the development of "Dream Sketcher".
[h2]Regarding the script[/h2]
In terms of the plot, we want to tell various themes such as folk monsters, disaster survival, secret exploration, and mystery tracking through "Dream Sketcher", encompassing different types of stories such as suspense, adventure, and emotion. Therefore, we chose the world view of investigating the subconscious dream, which is very inclusive. We hope to create a differentiated experience by continuously strengthening the plot content and performance, and forming a sense of plot immersion.
In terms of the mechanism, we try our best to produce different mechanisms for each script, design light and dark clues, reasoning elements, multi-scene settings, and different endings, striving to enrich the script experience. For example, in the evidence investigation and reasoning aspect, it is generally rare in similar games. Firstly, the single game time is short, and secondly, even the most exciting reasoning cannot withstand repetition. But without thinking and reasoning, how can you be called an investigator? So we tried to design minimalist reasoning, a few clues, one decision, to determine whether you can achieve a perfect ending. We also added some randomness to make the reasoning results different in each game, thereby enhancing replayability.
[h2]Regarding the card[/h2]
In previous tests, the card system had the problem of high learning difficulty, and the lack of differences between cards resulted in a monotonous battle experience of choosing cards, rolling dice, and killing monsters. Currently, we are heavily optimizing the cards and skills, and our main ideas are:
[b]1. Add cards with clear and concise effects, and strengthen the linkage between cards.[/b] Currently, many cards are difficult to understand, have poor effects, and lack coordination. We will design more cards with direct and cooperative effects, and strive to let players experience the satisfaction of continuous play, forming combos, and defeating monsters.
Tell AI what to do next…


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43132636/1b0809e553fe6e73cc4866d118c8cc9a6182edb9.png[/img]

[Developing card game: Simplify the text instructions for more intuitive card effects]
[b]2. Increase the number of exclusive cards for each character to highlight the differences between them.[/b] We will introduce more cards with special functions like "Brainwash", "Divination", and "Wealthy Way", which will add more unique mechanisms and statuses, enriching gameplay possibilities.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43132636/096a4e63591b60da72fda35f8fbf2203eed23e93.png[/img]

[Developing Card Game: More Unique Cards for Different Characters]
[b]3. Enhancing the involvement of players outside of the turn and encouraging them to participate more in their teammates' actions. [/b]We will modify the checking system so that everyone can participate in each check, and all cards can be used for checking by default, providing 1 point of checking value. At the same time, we will increase the strength and functionality of checking cards, allowing each deck to find suitable checking cards as lubricants.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43132636/ab5a245de184bbf2e7e095b6ddc3f3fdc072c7c5.png[/img]

[Developing Card Game: More Targeted Effects for Check Cards]
In addition, we have optimized the equipment slot design and the issue of key items taking up space. Please experience and provide feedback in the upcoming testing.
[h2]Mechanism[/h2]
Some players have pointed out that the current temporary madness in the game lacks the disruptive and dramatic effect of a tabletop RPG.
Therefore, we have designed a series of highly interactive madness effects for multiplayer mode. When a player falls into madness, they will have a strong desire that cannot be satisfied. If left unfulfilled, they will lose their sanity every turn and die faster. This desire could be a masochistic craving for punishment or a violent tendency to attack teammates. When faced with an unknown and crazy teammate, will you choose to help them or avoid them?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43132636/a9eb2ab8dbc04ccdeee7d6fc0533095c5c4e1041.png[/img]


Some players have expressed that there are too many negative effects in the dice roll check, and the function of human-ghost luck is unclear.
[b]We have merged all special symbols except for good and bad luck into a unified symbol "luck". When rolling the dice, players can choose one of three random faces to execute, with certain rewards and punishments. We hope this mechanism will increase players' sense of control over dice results. At the same time, when rolling good luck, we have also designed a set of more powerful random effects for players to choose from.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43132636/50c3d43d5551a58a380b76b2d4118c6678f4d24d.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43132636/18cd3ef7f5d56258377848658dc4127e52b4807c.png[/img]

Some players have said that the encounter experience is repetitive and boring.
[b]We are currently designing a batch of encounters that are more integrated with the plot, have strategic elements, and have positive effects. We strive to enrich the experience of the encounter stage, so that it is no longer a segment where everyone suffers.[/b]
[h1]Future Plans for "Dream Sketcher"[/h1]
Next, we will launch [b]more scripts with different themes[/b], including folk legends, disaster accidents, mysterious adventures, and other subjects. Players can unlock script achievements to receive special card rewards.
We are also exploring [b]more ways to increase replayability[/b], such as elements of Roguelike dungeon crawling, to test the waters for larger updates with greater randomness.
[b]PvP elements are also in the works[/b], and the traitor mode we previously attempted will return in an appropriate manner. Of course, there will also be new characters and new cards.
[h1]What We Want to Say in Response to Criticism[/h1]
[b]The game was inspired by TRPG table games, and our idea was to create innovative gameplay based on a similar framework. However, the previous version made everyone feel that the experience was too similar, which was not our original intention. We apologize for this! We have taken everyone's questions and critiques to heart, and are constantly improving the game design. We sincerely ask everyone to experience the new version and continue to provide feedback and criticism![/b]
[b]But we also want to clarify that we really don't just want to make a quick buck and run. Who would choose this kind of game, which has a highly vertical category, high production difficulty, and fast content consumption, just to make quick money? Many of the shortcomings pointed out by everyone are indeed due to our limited ability and lack of time to solve them, but we will never try to cover them up. We also hope that everyone can be more tolerant and patient. In addition, the official version of the game will be a one-time purchase with a reasonable price and without any microtransaction card-drawing elements.[/b]
We understand that every video view, demo download, new room creation, every player who joins the group, leaves a message, reports a problem, or raises a question, is our precious asset. We have no words to repay you, only a better "Dream Sketcher" to give back to everyone! Once again, thank you for everyone's concern, encouragement, critique, and correction!
[h1]Answering Some Frequently Asked Questions[/h1]
Q: How will the game be monetized?
A: It will be a one-time purchase model, without any microtransaction card-drawing elements. In the future, DLCs will be released to expand scripts, characters, and new modes.
Q: Will there be a Creative Workshop?
A: It can be done, but it is not a top priority. We need to polish the game first before we can better inspire players' creativity.
Q: The current game interface feels like a cheap mobile game. Will it be optimized?
A: The game interface has been redesigned and produced, incorporating many good suggestions from everyone. We will release some effect pictures in the future to continue to solicit everyone's opinions.
Q: I don't like the art style of the card face in the game. Will it be changed?
A: Actually, we intentionally made the card face into a humorous and nostalgic cartoon style, hoping to add some relaxation to the overall investigation atmosphere. Through testing, we found that some players do not accept this style. However, given our current financial and time costs, it is not feasible to replace the card face. Of course, we have also made great progress compared to our initial selves. When designing new card faces, we will increase the proportion of exploration, investigation, bizarre enemies, and items, gradually updating and upgrading the card art style.

notes.title: Development Log of "Dream Sketcher" | Optimization for the New Version Festival
notes.notes:
Dear investigators, Happy New Year!

First of all, I wish you all good luck in the Year of the Rabbit, and hope that you will have a prosperous year ahead.
Before the Spring Festival, facing a pile of bugs and the enthusiastic feedback from investigators, my head became as big as my stomach without me even realizing it... However, after several discussions (in fact, it was a battle of the planners, producers, and programmers for 300 rounds), we have identified 6 major areas that need to be optimized urgently: [b][Operation], [Interface], [Function], [Scenario], [Art], and [Music][/b]. We will start with these 6 areas and more than 70 small items to gradually upgrade the gaming experience of investigators. Let's take a look at the content of the new version of "Dream Sketcher" together!

[b](P.S. There will be a surprise at the end of the article, so please pay attention!)
Four pictures to understand the main changes in the game[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43132636/21bba5523c6b8d0947d773202f34df8cdfbad775.png[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43132636/b8e53a5b18c754c96ca1f040f72f689ca7d531bc.png[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43132636/656f0eca53538603605c5ceb97447dfbae7ab44a.png[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43132636/a22ed01124ca90231312991d6a1c9fec736dbb17.png[/img]



[h3]Specific optimization items are as follows[/h3]
---Warning for too many words! Warning for too many words! Warning for too many words!---

1. Add light effect feedback when clicking on the ground to move with the mouse; clearly indicate non-movable areas through changes in the cursor
2. Add the function of automatically moving the screen when the mouse is placed on the edge of the screen to facilitate targeting distant targets (this function can be turned on and off in the settings interface; when turned on, it can be quickly returned to the character's location through shortcut keys)
3. Optimize some issues that may cause delayed response to operations
4. Hand card partition
● Hand cards and equipment cards partition
● Sort hand card area by card type
● Adjust the maximum number of hand cards to 8, encourage everyone to use hand card resources as soon as possible, and avoid accumulation of a large number of cards
5. Information display
● Modified the artistic scheme of the health bar after severe injury or madness, making it easier for everyone to understand the state changes
● Optimize the TIP content of character and monster information, making it easier for everyone to understand the ability information of characters and monsters
● Optimize the artistic scheme of the robbery information, and clearly display the round limit and progress changes
● Separate equipment information and buff information at the character's avatar to avoid confusion
6. Action points
● When the action points change, add button animation prompts to guide everyone's attention to the changes in action points and the end of the round operation
● Uniform action point-related icons everywhere to avoid ambiguity
● When the action points are insufficient, add clear prompts in the corresponding module
● Improve or add clear prompts for action point consumption in key modules
7. Check interface
● Add a "?" button in the check interface to view special dice face effect instructions; (in the future, card and character skill effect display will be added)
● Add a clear display of the part where the card effect does not take effect when non-check cards are put into the check to avoid ambiguity
8. Cards
● In the card description, highlight the keywords, optimize the TIP art, and make it easier to read
● The "omni" symbol on the card surface is no longer displayed as "?", avoiding ambiguity
● Uniform artistic scheme for attribute symbols everywhere to avoid ambiguity
9. NPC interaction option artistic scheme optimization to avoid missing non-combat options such as "negotiation"
10. Chat
● Player's speech is displayed in a bubble at the left avatar
● Player's nickname is displayed near the avatar
11. Novice
● Improve the introduction of key rules in the novice tutorial: focus on supplementing card-related; (in the future, a detailed encyclopedia manual will be implanted in the game, which can be consulted at any time for detailed rule settings)
● Optimize the "Enter the Dream" part of the novice tutorial: the overall process will be smoother and easier to understand
12. Appropriately reduce the difficulty of single-player gameplay

[h3]Current and future optimization directions[/h3]
Currently, the specific optimization goals of several directions we have determined are as follows:
[Operation]: We focus on improving the poor hand feel of movement and card operation, unreasonable UI interaction and other issues, strengthening interaction response and feedback, improving relevant functional mechanisms, and enhancing everyone's operational fluency (subsequent adjustments will be made according to everyone's feedback, as appropriate)
[Interface]: We iteratively reshape the interface in the script, cooperate with animations and other forms to reasonably distinguish and convey key information areas, and make the interface presentation clear and clear to ensure that everyone can clearly see the key information during the game
[Function]: Enhance card and check-related teaching in the novice tutorial, add an in-game encyclopedia manual; at the same time, enhance the compatibility of single players, further reduce the threshold for playing games, and expand everyone's card gameplay and strategic space
[Script]: Optimize the text paragraph display function of the script to facilitate everyone's clear reading; at the same time, for everyone's needs for the randomness, multi-branching, enhanced character shaping and sense of substitution of the script, we will launch a map, events, clues with strong randomness in the future, and scripts with rich branching endings and other contents
[Art]: Optimize the texture accuracy of in-game scenes and characters, add lighting baking, etc., to improve artistic quality while optimizing performance and enhance everyone's visual experience
[Music]: Add music and sound effects to the opening animation, UI main interface, and script of the game, and optimize everyone's auditory experience.

This version update mainly prioritizes solving the problems of operation feel and interface that everyone cares about, in addition to these, we will further optimize the game [script] [art] [music] and other modules, such as improving the novice guidance tutorial, adding game opening animation, streamlining script content and presentation, upgrading BGM sound effects, etc., so that everyone can better understand the game worldview and enhance the sense of substitution during the game. We will also update the development log in a timely manner for the new optimization content.

[h3][b]【Surprise here!】[/b][/h3]
[h3][b]● "Chiller" will participate in Steam's new product festival in 2023!
● New product festival time: February 6th to February 13th
● At that time, all investigators can experience the optimized game version (including the optimization items in this log) + a new script (the upgraded and remade version of "Murder Sanatorium") during the new product festival![/b][/h3]

You can leave your questions of interest through the comment area, private message to the official ins, twitter, or ytb account. We will collect various questions from everyone and answer them in the next issue. Sketcher Hotline, always online!

notes.title: "Dream Sketcher" Q&A for the initial penetration test:
notes.notes:
Dear investigators,

Thank you for your support on the multiplayer investigation adventure game "Dream Sketcher". The closed beta test has come to an end, and we have received many suggestions and feedback. Today, we will answer some of the questions that you are concerned about, summarize the test situation, and report our current development progress to everyone.

[b]Answers to Investigator Questions[/b]
Q: The operation experience of some movements, interfaces, and interactive card usage in this test is not good, and there are often response delay issues.
A: We have noticed this issue and have started to optimize it technically. In addition, we are also considering optimizing the suggestions made by many investigators, such as card organization and partition.
Q: The music and sound effects in this version are a bit out of place. Will they be optimized later?
A: We will continue to optimize the music and sound effects to find more suitable versions. This version is not satisfactory due to limited time and resources, and the AI voiceover is also a last resort. By the way, how about having the girl who conducted this telephone interview (perhaps just the group owner's voice changer) to do the voiceover?
Q: Will there be a creative workshop?
A: We have seen many players calling for creative modules. We really want to implement this feature, but our current manpower is very limited. We are focusing on writing scripts and optimizing the game, which takes up almost all of our time. Therefore, we hope to have the energy to do it later. Once we are ready, we will inform everyone in time!
Q: The art style of the cards is quite different from the other art styles in the game.
A: This is intentional. We want to create a contrast between the "realistic dark" scene characters and the cartoon humorous card pictures, while also deepening everyone's memory.
Q: Many rules in the game are difficult to understand, and new players don't know how to play. What should we do?
A: We will make the following adjustments:
1. Simplify some system modules, such as the current damage calculation method, to reduce the threshold for understanding the rules;
2. Make some adjustments to the interface and increase more prompt information, so that the purpose of each place can be more intuitively expressed;
3. Optimize the card copywriting to make the card rules clearer and easier to understand;
4. Improve the guidance tutorial and add a teaching manual in the game for everyone to refer to at any time.
Q: The game cannot freely use the cards now, it does not feel like a role-playing game.
A: The core gameplay of "Dream Sketcher" is derived from classic COC board games such as "Arkham horror" and "Mansions of Madness", while also incorporating our own thinking and design. Our gameplay form is definitely different from the ideal form in the hearts of current domestic role-playing game players. For example, we cannot achieve very free use of cards, and there are limits to the event branches and solutions in the script. Therefore, we do not claim to be a purely "role-playing" game, but use the description of "class role-playing games". Our original intention was to use electronic means to retain some core fun elements while simplifying the threshold. On the one hand, it allows interested enthusiasts to have a quick and flexible entertainment when needed, and on the other hand, it also hopes to popularize related culture and fun to a wider range of players. We are currently supplementing more background stories and improving specialized abilities for investigator roles, and we will also consider opening up some space for free collocation in this part in the future.
Q: What is the development team busy with now, and when will the game be launched?
A: We are working hard to produce new scripts while collecting and organizing testing feedback through group communication, questionnaires, telephone, and other methods. Our goal is to launch as soon as possible in the first half of 2023!

Currently, we are developing new scripts and upgrading the old ones that are highly requested by everyone! Here are some scenes and NPC pictures that are currently being produced:

Going forward, we will regularly communicate with everyone about the progress of game development. Any questions or suggestions can be left in our official community, and we will summarize them and reply in a unified manner.
In addition, we welcome you to add "Dream Sketcher" to your Steam wishlist. Your support and attention are very important to us!
Finally, we wish you all a happy New Year in advance! Please be sure to take protective measures and welcome 2023 in good health!

notes.title: Hello！We're Rising Punch!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, this is Rising Punch (RP) Studio! After going through various hardships, our first game "Dream Sketcher" is about to meet you all. We hope to bring you the joy of adventuring together and exploring the unknown!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43132636/81b792e0e01f4aa4f96f6de8891ec7fbe089c402.jpg[/img]

Rising Punch is a small independent game team formed by several friends who share common interests. We came together with the hope of creating unique games.
Inspired by classic board games such as "Arkham horror: The Card Game", "Mansions of Madness" and "Betrayal Legacy" we added our own ideas and blended our love of classic action-adventure, horror, and suspense films from the golden age. This led us to develop "Dream Sketcher," a game that offers players the opportunity to have fun as the protagonist of their own adventure story, either as an individual or with a team, with a convenient starting point.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43132636/9fe2199dc31ffe853da0ae490e4368951614226a.png[/img]
Developing games is not a simple task, and choosing to develop "Dream Sketcher" has given our team a hellish difficulty level from the beginning: in terms of gameplay, we need to ensure a certain degree of freedom, provide players with multiple paths to solve problems, design a rich space for card strategy construction, and think about how to convey complex rules in a more understandable way... and the ability for multiple players to join in real-time also puts a considerable amount of pressure on our small team... Finally, we understand why there are few similar games in the market.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43132636/fb6f23c627f218a8e1e576324759653943841e8f.png[/img]
Our first-generation product is bound to have various shortcomings, but we will strive to persist in it as a long-term career and hope to continue iterating and polishing with everyone's support. Finally, please add "Dream Sketcher" to your wishlist and keep an eye on us!
